static-diff.title: zsasa against FreeSASA, structure by structure
static-diff.note: 4,370 E. coli AlphaFold structures. Each dot is one structure: its total SASA from FreeSASA, and how far zsasa is from that value. Negative values mean zsasa reports less area.

static-points.title: Difference from FreeSASA by sphere-point count
static-points.note: 4,370 E. coli AlphaFold structures. Lines are medians of the signed relative difference; bands span the 5th to 95th percentile.

md-points.title: Difference from MDTraj by sphere-point count
md-points.note: 1,001 frames of the 5wvo_C trajectory, MDTraj computed frame by frame. Lines are medians of the signed relative difference; bands span the 5th to 95th percentile.

md-bitmask.title: Trajectory bitmask mode against exact zsasa
md-bitmask.note: 1,001 frames of the 5wvo_C trajectory, relative to zsasa CLI f32 at the same sphere-point count. Lines are medians; bands span the 5th to 95th percentile.
